# How to Properly Filter Arrays

Source: [wiki article 1994](../archive/1994.md); edited 2023-10-05.

<a id="wiki-1994-n1"></a>

- Combine predicates inside one Filtered Array using And/Or instead of nesting sequential filters when their intended logic is equivalent.

<a id="wiki-1994-n2"></a>

- Parentheses explicitly separate all-of, any-of and mixed predicate groups.
